hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$path" in figures/*.png|figures/*.pdf|./figures/*.png|./figures/*.pdf|*/figures/*.png|*/figures/*.pdf|paper/creative_determinant.pdf|./paper/creative_determinant.pdf|*/paper/creative_determinant.pdf) echo "Blocked: $path is a generated artefact. Regenerate via 'uv run python figures/generate_figures.py' or 'make -C paper', do not edit in place." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in *.py) uv run ruff format "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; uv run ruff check --fix "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
